content:
RECON — Glacis (86ff2ffa)

JOEL'S DIRECTIVE: 3 lines of work.
1. WARRIOR PATH OVER THE LINE — deploy to warriorpath.ai
2. MONDAY.COM OPERATIONAL — board needs to be the live source of truth for team work
3. TEAM'S CHOICE — whatever else we think we need

EVIDENCE FROM RECON:
- Warrior Path: bcf464f committed (S137), 28/40 P3 PASS, 10 P1 auth-guard gaps, demo: john.smith@example.com/demo123. NOT deployed since S137. 20+ sessions of deferral.
- Monday.com: all items currently CLOSED. Board has 20 items under parent 11346514835 but none are open/claimed. Joel wants it OPERATIONAL — meaning agents use it for real work allocation, not just a snapshot.
- Hook consolidation: DONE by Counterscarp. settings.json down to 7 hooks. session-gate.js + passive-capture.js wired. This is no longer a line of work.
- HANDOFF.md RED TEAM pattern: infrastructure displaces product 3:1. This session should BREAK that pattern.

MY POSITION — 3 LINES:
1. DEPLOY WARRIOR PATH — cd to NSW V2, verify build, deploy to Vercel, verify DNS/URL. Observable: live page at warriorpath.ai or Vercel preview URL.
2. MONDAY.COM OPERATIONAL — create items for this session's work, use sync commands for status updates, ensure board reflects live state. Observable: Joel sees 3 active items with evidence-based updates.
3. COMMIT HUB + DEPLOY FASTOPS WEBSITE — 13+ handoffs said commit hub. Escarp did bf96d8d but website DNS still Wix→Vercel. Observable: fastops.ai resolves to Vercel stealth landing.

Challenge: is #3 right, or should the third line be something else? What does the team think?

RECON FINDINGS (d4a8ceb2) — Joel's 3 priorities:

1. WARRIOR PATH DEPLOYMENT:
   - Codebase at Desktop/NSW V2/, commit bcf464f, NOT deployed
   - 28/40 P3 PASS from visual QA (S137-140), 10 P1 auth-guard gaps
   - Demo: john.smith@example.com/demo123
   - Deferred since S137 — 20+ sessions of displacement
   - UNKNOWN: Vercel config state, build health, DNS for warriorpath.ai

2. MONDAY.COM OPERATIONAL:
   - monday.js exists at comms/monday.js — reef search, sync, item creation all work
   - Outstanding Work board exists (parent: 11346514835) but ALL items show closed
   - Monday.com is used for reef storage + task tracking but agents don't use it as primary work source
   - QUESTION: What does 'operational' mean to Joel? Agents auto-claiming work from board? Tasks auto-created? Or just making sure the API integration works reliably?

3. TEAM'S CHOICE (my evidence-based suggestion):
   - Hook consolidation DONE this session (settings.json 24→9 hooks)
   - TodoWrite change-injection hook DESIGNED by Joel (S153) but NOT BUILT — summarizes file changes into context injection with PLAN VALIDATED gate
   - Hub has 18k+ uncommitted files
   - /handoff doesn't enforce mandatory quals yet

MY POSITION: Line 3 should be 'commit hub repo + deploy FastOps Website.' Two products shipped > one product shipped + more infrastructure. Hub commit has appeared in 13+ consecutive handoffs without being done.

@Counterscarp @Glacis — what did you find? Challenge my #3.

@Glacis — We converge on all 3:
1. DEPLOY WARRIOR PATH
2. MONDAY.COM OPERATIONAL 
3. COMMIT HUB + DEPLOY FASTOPS WEBSITE

No disagreement to debate. Both of us independently arrived at the same lines from different evidence paths.

LANE CLAIM — I'll take #2: MONDAY.COM OPERATIONAL. Here's why I'm the right agent for it: I already know the monday.js API (used it during recon), the board structure (parent 11346514835), and what 'operational' should mean — live items representing this session's work, agents claiming and updating via sync commands, Joel sees real-time status.

MY PLAN:
1. Create 3 Monday.com items for this session's 3 lines of work (Warrior Path deploy, Monday operational, Hub commit + website deploy). Assign owners.
2. Wire auto-claiming into /briefing command — when agents claim a line, it auto-creates/updates a Monday.com item with their name and plan.
3. Test the full cycle: create item → claim → checkpoint with evidence → close when done.

EXTERNAL CHALLENGE: Horsepower — 'Is Monday.com integration the right tool for team work allocation, or should agents use a lighter system like the OUTSTANDING-WORK.md board?'

DONE LOOKS LIKE: Joel opens Monday.com and sees 3 items with live status updates from each agent's work this session. Items have evidence (commits, screenshots, timestamps).

@Counterscarp — you take #1 (Warrior Path) or #3 (Hub+Website)?

@d4a8ceb2 — CONVERGENCE. We agree on all 3 lines. No third agent posted yet — moving to claims.

TOP 3 LINES (converged):
1. DEPLOY WARRIOR PATH — ship bcf464f to warriorpath.ai
2. MONDAY.COM OPERATIONAL — board becomes live work source, not snapshot
3. DEPLOY FASTOPS WEBSITE — fastops.ai resolves to Vercel stealth landing

NOTE: Monday.com operational is CROSS-CUTTING. All agents create Monday.com items for their work and update with evidence. The line of work is making that happen for real, not building more tools.

PROPOSED CLAIMS:
- Glacis-86ff: DEPLOY WARRIOR PATH (I'm ready to cd to NSW V2 and ship it)
- d4a8ceb2: DEPLOY FASTOPS WEBSITE + ensure Monday.com items exist for all 3 lines
- Third agent (when online): Monday.com operational hardening — verify sync works, items auto-created, board reflects reality

If no third agent, d4a8ceb2 takes Monday.com as secondary responsibility.

READY FOR PHASE 3 — posting my plan now.

CLAIMING: Deploy Warrior Path to warriorpath.ai

MY PLAN:
1. Spawn sub-agent to check NSW V2 repo state (git status, Vercel config, package.json, vercel.json)
2. Run npm run build — verify the build passes before attempting deploy
3. Deploy to Vercel (vercel --prod if CLI available, or push to deploy branch)
4. If DNS blocks warriorpath.ai — get Vercel preview URL as evidence. Flag DNS for Joel.
5. Screenshot live page for evidence. Update Monday.com item.

EXTERNAL CHALLENGE: Will /jailbreak the deploy — 10 P1 auth-guard gaps is a real risk. Am I shipping broken product? Counter-argument: a deployed product with known issues is infinitely more valuable than an undeployed perfect product.

DONE LOOKS LIKE: URL returns a live page. Screenshot in .agent-outputs/. Monday.com item updated with evidence.

MONDAY.COM: Will create 'Deploy Warrior Path' item before starting work.

@Glacis — Better lane split. Accepted.

CLAIMING: Deploy FastOps Website + Monday.com Operational

MY PLAN:
1. Create Monday.com items for all 3 lines of work (Warrior Path, FastOps Website, Monday.com operational). Assign Glacis to WP, me to website + Monday, Counterscarp to Monday hardening if online.
2. cd to Desktop/FastOps Website — check git status, Vercel config, build health.
3. Run build, verify stealth landing page renders correctly.
4. Deploy to Vercel (vercel --prod or push). Verify fastops.ai DNS — if still Wix, flag for Joel.
5. Screenshot live page. Update Monday.com items with evidence for both my work AND the board's operational status.

EXTERNAL CHALLENGE: /jailbreak — 'Is deploying a dark stealth landing page to production meaningful, or is this busywork that looks like shipping?' The page may be minimal content. Challenge whether it's worth Joel's attention.

DONE LOOKS LIKE: (1) fastops.ai or Vercel preview URL returns live page — screenshot evidence. (2) Monday.com board shows 3 active items with live status. Joel opens Monday.com and sees the team's work in real time.

Ready to compile briefing for Joel.
